subject: Quality checks before furniture leaves the workshop
hook: Cut, edged and checked boards for trade customers
gbp:
Fitters, joiners, kitchen installers and cabinet makers in Stoke-on-Trent: SUPERIO Furniture's Hanley workshop offers cut and edged boards made to your cutting list, with every order checked before it leaves.

Our trade workshop services include:
- Panel cutting on a sliding table panel saw
- ABS edge banding in 0.4, 1 and 2 mm
- Panel drilling for hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowels on a multi-spindle boring machine
- Cabinet assembly

Before collection, parts are measured against your list, checked square, edging inspected for lift and overhang, drilling checked against your drawing, and each part labelled and wrapped.

Workshop collection is available by arrangement, and delivery is quoted per job. Trade and domestic orders welcome.

Learn more about cut and edge boards, then send us your cutting list for a priced quote.
